## Jev + Gemini, with a complete Gemini-only path
This node was tested in the webinar n8n Cloud account on 5 November. It used Gateway credits and returned review, confidence 1, model jev-1.14.0 for the sample. That is one test, not an accuracy benchmark.

Select Gateway credits if offered and confirm a positive balance, or use your TypeSafe credential. Availability/credits vary by attendee. If the node or credits are unavailable, skip this optional workflow; 01-04 still work with Gemini. Jev does not generate replies and never replaces the INR 5000 code rule.
